183:t_013:12.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「...But $$ジン$$, $$カグラ$$, and Chairwoman $$クレア$$ aren't here...」

183:t_013:13.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Did they get thrown off!?」

183:t_013:14.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I can't imagine Chairwoman $$クレア$$ making a mistake like that, though...」

183:t_013:15.en:
$$シュレード$$
「It must be Supreme Commander $$不動$$'s idea. I'm sure he's plotting something again and keeping it secret from us.」

183:t_013:17.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Let's get angry later! First we have to deal with the parting gift $$ミカゲ$$ left us!」

183:t_013:18.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$アルト$$! Back us up over here!」

183:t_013:19.en:
$$アルト$$
($$ミカゲ$$... Don't tell me that guy...)

183:t_013:22.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Your job is to back up $$アマタ$$! Hurry!」

183:t_014:0.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Well now... We're thrown into a battlefield out of nowhere, but let's do this, $$アマタ$$, $$カイエン$$!」

183:t_014:1.en:
$$カイエン$$
「We're ready whenever you are, $$アマタ$$!」

183:t_014:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「All right...! I'll try out the new move from our special training, too!」

183:t_015:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ユノハ$$!」

183:t_015:1.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I'm ready anytime! When the time comes to use that, I'll be right there with you!」

183:t_015:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Here we go! I won't lose to $$ミカゲ$$'s hatred!」

183:t_016:0.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Yeah, a flawless victory! Well... it's thanks to us, of course!」

183:t_016:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Tch... $$アンディ$$ is as carefree as ever.」

183:t_016:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「On top of the $$インベーダー#pilot$$ invasion of Earth, now $$ミカゲ$$ shows up again...」

183:t_016:3.en:
$n
「$$サイデリアル$$, and $$クロノ$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ following them... And on top of that, the fight against $$バアル$$...」

183:t_016:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「And $$ミカゲ$$, who has the power to destroy the world all by himself...」

183:t_016:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「No use thinking about it. I'll settle what's right in front of us first.」

183:t_016:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The capture of the imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$... We absolutely have to make it a success.」

183:t_017:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then let me tell you all something nice.」

183:t_017:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The girl with the pale pink and gold hair, and the girl with the spring-green hair... Wouldn't you like to know where they are?」

183:t_017:4.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain! Some kind of data is being sent to the $$クォーター$$!」

183:t_017:5.en:
$$ラム$$
「This is... coordinates of a location on Earth!」

183:t_017:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$ミカゲ$$'s doing, then.」

183:t_017:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ there!?」

183:t_017:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You'll have to confirm that with your own eyes.」

183:t_018:1.en:
$$シュレード$$
「It's useless, $$アルト$$. Chasing him is impossible.」

183:t_018:2.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「But what on earth does he want with $$シェリル$$ and the others...」

183:t_018:3.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「This is that sly pretty boy we're talking about! It's obviously a trap!」

183:t_018:4.en:
$$モロイ$$
「But it's too unnatural for a trap.」

183:t_018:5.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「He tried to use $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ during the $$時獄戦役$$ too...」

183:t_018:6.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「So he's trying to use the two of them for his own purposes again?」

183:t_018:7.en:
$$クラン$$
「But if that's the case, he could just kidnap the two of them himself...」

183:t_018:10.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, return to base. Thinking about what his words meant can wait.」

183:t_018:11.en:
$$アルト$$
($$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$... Are you two really there...)

183:t_019:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Yes, sir. Thanks to each team's organic combinations, they are achieving results beyond their rated combat strength.」

183:t_019:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Good...! Go on the offensive all at once! We'll take this chance to scatter $$バアル$$!」

183:t_020:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Whoa! It's the outrageous move I've been waiting for!」

183:t_020:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Amazing...! As expected of $$アクエリオン$$!」

183:t_020:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「This is it! It just wouldn't be $$アクエリオン$$ without this!」

183:t_020:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「All right! A huge success, $$ユノハ$$!」

183:t_020:4.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「Yes! I'm so happy my power was useful!」

183:t_020:5.en:
$$カイエン$$
「A combo of $$アマタ$$'s and $$ユノハ$$'s $$エレメント$$ abilities, huh. Not bad.」

183:t_020:6.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Well, $$ミコノ$$? Feeling a little jealous?」

183:t_020:7.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Wow, both $$アマタ$$ and $$ユノハ$$! I have to do my best too!」

183:t_020:8.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Ahaha... I guess it was pointless to even ask.」

183:t_020:9.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Nobody can cut in on their bond anymore. Not even a god or a devil.」

183:t_100:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(It's the same as in that dream... $$誰か$$ is trying to peer into my heart...)

183:t_101:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
($$ミカゲ$$...! If you're still trapped in hatred and mean to destroy the world, we'll be your opponents...!)

183:t_101:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
(I don't care about $$アポロ$$ or the Winged Dog $$ポロン$$! To protect the world that $$ミコノ$$ and I love, I'll stop you!)

183:t_102:0.en:
$$刹那$$
($$ソレスタルビーイング$$ will keep fighting to rid this world of war...)

183:t_102:1.en:
$$刹那$$
(I'll fight no matter who the enemy is...! That is our mission!)

183:t_103:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
($$リリーナ$$... We will fight the enemies of the world. Leading the world after that is your job.)

183:t_104:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Wait for me, $$サイデリアル$$...! I'll repay my debt from $$新日本$$ at once...!)

183:t_104:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(I am $$ゼロ$$...! Whoever takes away the world's tomorrow, I will eliminate them myself!)

183:t_105:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Against an opponent like this, to whom words mean nothing, I cannot carry out my true duty.」

183:t_105:1.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Well, it can't be helped this time.」

183:t_105:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now that $$ドロシー#bigo$$ has given her permission, I shall proceed without reservation.」

183:t_105:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「There is no need to hold back against brutes who cannot be reasoned with and have no heart! $$ビッグオー$$, Aaaaction!!」

183:t_106:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
($$フィアナ$$... Where is the world you wished for, I wonder...)

183:t_107:0.en:
$$シン$$
(Who cares about the truth about $$コーディネイター$$s...! I'll fight for what I believe in!)

183:t_107:1.en:
$$シン$$
(And I'll stop it, for sure! The war, and $$レイ#pt136$$!)

183:t_108:0.en:
$$キラ$$
(Wait for me, $$ラクス$$... I'll definitely come for you...)

183:t_108:1.en:
$$キラ$$
(And I'll definitely stop the fighting...! With my feelings and my strength...!)

183:t_109:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Take your pick of prey! I'll knock them all out of the sky, one after another!」
